summary: Frontend-only verification of chart-page no-timeout-hang fixes (fix #4). ALL 5 requested flows PASS: (1) NORMAL FLOW /asset/crypto/BTC direct: candlestick chart SVG rendered in ~3s, BTC header price 82,250.10 with LIVE indicator, HIGH/LOW/VOLUME stats, no error banner, no console errors. (2) HANG SIM (chart API 500 after 5s delay): red error banner testID 'chart-retry' appeared at 8.4s with text 'Error: HTTP 500 ...' + 'Retry →' — NOT an infinite spinner. (3) RETRY: removed interception, tapped chart-retry → chart rendered, banner cleared. (4) TIMEFRAME SWITCH 5m: chart reloaded cleanly, no stuck state (note: '4h' does not exist in TIMEFRAMES list — initial test selector error, not an app bug). (5) REGRESSION: dashboard / loads with asset cards, premium counts, no panic text. BONUS real-hang run: intercepted chart requests left truly hanging — exactly 3 requests fired (30s AbortController abort + 150/300ms backoff retries as designed), banner with 'Error: Timeout 30000ms on /asset/crypto/BTC/chart?timeframe=1h' + Retry appeared at ~90s. The 30s AbortController path is fully validated end-to-end.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated RN style props in console: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — warnings only, no functional impact. Reference: multiple components app-wide.
2 pageerrors on dashboard: 'The element has no supported sources.' — an audio/video element (likely alert sound asset) with no valid source on web preview. Pre-existing, unrelated to this fix.

action_items: OPTIONAL (UX): worst-case full-hang now takes ~90s (3 attempts x 30s) before the error banner shows. Consider skipping the 3-attempt backoff for AbortController timeouts (a hung upstream won't recover in 450ms) to surface the retry banner after ~30s.
OPTIONAL (hygiene): migrate deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents props; fix dashboard media element with no supported sources.
CODE QUALITY: /app/frontend/app/asset/[market]/[symbol].tsx is 1854 lines (>700 guideline) — consider splitting AI Consensus / prediction card into separate components.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts get() timeout impl is correct: AbortController only when timeoutMs provided, timer cleared in finally, abort mapped to 'Timeout {ms}ms on {path}' which matches the asset page's /timeout/i retryable regex — intended interaction verified live (3 requests observed during real hang).
chart-retry TouchableOpacity correctly re-invokes loadChart(timeframe); banner gating 'error && !loadingChart' prevents flicker during reload — verified: banner cleared and chart rendered after tap.
AuthContext 8s verify abort and subscriptionContext 6s Promise.race on initIap present at expected lines; cold-start gate (profileLoaded && accessLoaded) can no longer hang indefinitely.
No mocked APIs involved; chart data served by real preview backend in ~1-3s.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: three no-timeout hangs could gate the chart forever — (1) api.chart() fetch with no timeout → infinite skeleton; (2) AuthContext /auth/verify cold-start fetch hang kept authLoaded=false → accessLoaded gate blocked loadChart; (3) subscriptionContext initIap() (Play Billing initConnection) hang kept subLoaded=false → same gate. Fixes verified working: 30s AbortController on chart fetch (Timeout error surfaces via banner), 8s verify abort, 6s initIap race, and tappable chart-retry banner. Validated with real never-responding request: 3 aborted attempts then banner at ~90s, retry recovers.
